final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_count) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - stats.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN stats WHERE s.share > stats.avg_share
